top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks are a mature, independently realized method that has opened a new regime of precision measurement and demonstrated value for fundamental tests. Katori and Ye offer a bounded attribution to complementary foundational contributions; the citation should distinguish that work from later performance advances.
recusal_note: No direct connection to the proposed laureates is apparent from my profile. I am a Chalmers colleague of Göran Johansson and work in the same city as Bernhard Mehlig; these are institutional relationships, not direct ties to the proposed achievement.
